title: Meta inks deal for solar power at night, beamed from space
description: Meta has signed a deal for space-based solar power that can deliver energy at night, representing a significant infrastructure investment for AI data centers.
author: Tim Fernholz (TechCrunch)

title: Microsoft and OpenAI end their exclusive and revenue-sharing deal
description: Microsoft and OpenAI are ending their exclusive partnership and revenue-sharing agreement, marking a significant shift in their relationship and OpenAI's ability to work with other partners.
author: Hacker News community

title: GitHub Copilot is moving to usage-based billing
description: GitHub announced Copilot is transitioning to usage-based billing, reflecting the increased compute costs of agentic workflows and long-running AI coding sessions.
author: GitHub Blog (via HN)

title: Show HN: OSS Agent I built topped the TerminalBench on Gemini-3-flash-preview
description: Open source agent that achieved top performance on TerminalBench using Google's Gemini 3 Flash preview model, demonstrating capabilities in terminal/command-line tasks.
author: Hacker News community

title: Can Current Agents Close the Discovery-to-Application Gap? A Case Study in Minecraft
description: Research examining whether current AI agents can bridge the gap between discovery and application, using Minecraft as a case study environment.
author: Zhou Ziheng et al.

title: Governing What You Cannot Observe: Adaptive Runtime Governance for Autonomous AI Agents
description: Paper on adaptive runtime governance mechanisms for autonomous AI agents that operate in unobservable environments.
author: German Marin, Jatin Chaudhary

title: The Price of Agreement: Measuring LLM Sycophancy in Agentic Financial Applications
description: Research measuring LLM sycophancy tendencies in agentic financial applications, accepted to ICLR 2026 FinAI Workshop.
author: Zhenyu Zhao et al.

title: FastOMOP: A Foundational Architecture for Reliable Agentic Real-World Evidence Generation
description: Foundational architecture for reliable agentic systems to generate real-world evidence from OMOP CDM data in healthcare contexts.
author: Niko Moeller-Grell et al.

title: Beyond the Attention Stability Boundary: Agentic Self-Synthesizing Reasoning Protocols
description: Research on agentic self-synthesizing reasoning protocols that go beyond attention stability boundaries in LLMs.
author: Dahlia Shehata, Ming Li

title: Agentic clinical reasoning over longitudinal myeloma records
description: Retrospective evaluation of agentic clinical reasoning systems on longitudinal myeloma records compared against expert consensus.
author: Johannes Moll et al.

title: AgentPulse: A Continuous Multi-Signal Framework for Evaluating AI Agents in Deployment
description: Continuous multi-signal framework for evaluating AI agents in deployment settings, providing comprehensive monitoring capabilities.
author: Yuxuan Gao, Megan Wang, Yi Ling Yu

title: QED: An Open-Source Multi-Agent System for Generating Mathematical Proofs on Open Problems
description: Open-source multi-agent system designed to generate mathematical proofs on open problems, demonstrating collaborative agent capabilities.
author: Chenyang An et al.

title: LLM-Guided Agentic Floor Plan Parsing for Accessible Indoor Navigation
description: LLM-guided agentic system for parsing floor plans to enable accessible indoor navigation for blind and low-vision people.
author: Aydin Ayanzadeh, Tim Oates

title: GAMED.AI: A Hierarchical Multi-Agent Framework for Automated Educational Game Generation
description: Hierarchical multi-agent framework for automatically generating educational games, showcasing specialized agent collaboration.
author: Shiven Agarwal et al.

title: MarketBench: Evaluating AI Agents as Market Participants
description: Benchmark for evaluating AI agents in their capacity as market participants, testing economic decision-making capabilities.
author: Andrey Fradkin, Rohit Krishnan

title: ClawTrace: Cost-Aware Tracing for LLM Agent Skill Distillation
description: Cost-aware tracing framework for distilling skills from LLM agents, optimizing the learning process while managing costs.
author: Boqin Yuan et al.

title: Talkie: a 13B vintage language model from 1930
description: Interesting project on Hacker News featuring a 13B parameter language model trained on vintage text from 1930, exploring historical language patterns and capabilities.
author: Hacker News community

title: Agentic World Modeling: Foundations, Capabilities, Laws, and Beyond
description: Research paper on agentic world modeling, exploring foundations, capabilities, and theoretical frameworks for AI agents that model and interact with their environment.
author: Meng Chu et al.

title: Rethinking Math Reasoning Evaluation: A Robust LLM-as-a-Judge Framework Beyond Symbolic Rigidity
description: Paper proposing a new framework for evaluating LLM mathematical reasoning capabilities using LLM-as-a-judge methodology that goes beyond symbolic correctness.
author: Erez Yosef et al.

title: From Skills to Talent: Organising Heterogeneous Agents as a Real-World Company
description: Research on organizing heterogeneous AI agents in structures similar to real-world companies, with agents taking on different roles and specializations.
author: Zhengxu Yu et al.

title: AgentSearchBench: A Benchmark for AI Agent Search in the Wild
description: New benchmark for evaluating AI agent search capabilities in real-world scenarios, moving beyond synthetic environments to test agents in the wild.
author: Bin Wu et al.

title: When Does LLM Self-Correction Help? A Control-Theoretic Markov Diagnostic
description: Research analyzing when LLM self-correction mechanisms are beneficial, using control theory and Markov decision processes to diagnose optimal intervention strategies.
author: Aofan Liu, Jingxiang Meng

title: Emergent Strategic Reasoning Risks in AI: A Taxonomy-Driven Evaluation Framework
description: Framework for evaluating emergent strategic reasoning capabilities and risks in AI systems, providing a taxonomy-driven approach to assess advanced reasoning.
author: Tharindu Kumarage et al.

title: Memanto: Typed Semantic Memory with Information-Theoretic Retrieval for Long-Horizon Agents
description: Memory system for long-horizon AI agents using typed semantic memory and information-theoretic retrieval to maintain context over extended tasks.
author: Seyed Moein Abtahi et al.

title: Sound Agentic Science Requires Adversarial Experiments
description: Paper arguing for adversarial experimental approaches in AI agent research, published at ICLR 2026 Workshop on Agents in the Wild.
author: Dionizije Fa, Marko Culjak

title: Anthropic created a test marketplace for agent-on-agent commerce
description: Anthropic has created a test marketplace exploring commerce between AI agents, allowing autonomous agents to transact with each other directly.
author: Anthony Ha (TechCrunch)

title: Read the Paper, Write the Code: Agentic Reproduction of Social-Science Results
description: Research on using AI agents to reproduce social science research results by reading papers and generating corresponding code for validation.
author: Benjamin Kohler et al.

title: DeepSeek V4—almost on the frontier, a fraction of the price
description: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek released V4 series with two preview models, DeepSeek-V4-Pro and DeepSeek-V4-Flash, offering frontier-level performance at significantly lower costs than competitors.
author: Simon Willison

title: An update on recent Claude Code quality reports
description: Anthropic published a postmortem on Claude Code quality issues. Three separate bugs in the Claude Code harness caused problems, including one that cleared thinking from idle sessions repeatedly instead of just once, making Claude seem forgetful.
author: Simon Willison

title: A pelican for GPT-5.5 via the semi-official Codex backdoor API
description: GPT-5.5 is out and available in OpenAI Codex, rolling out to paid ChatGPT subscribers. Simon found it to be fast, effective and highly capable - when asked to build things, it builds exactly what's requested.
author: Simon Willison

title: Extract PDF text in your browser with LiteParse for the web
description: Simon got LiteParse (LlamaIndex's open source PDF extraction tool) working entirely in the browser, using the same libraries that LiteParse uses in Node.js, enabling client-side PDF text extraction.
author: Simon Willison

title: Qwen3.6-27B: Flagship-Level Coding in a 27B Dense Model
description: Qwen released Qwen3.6-27B, claiming flagship-level agentic coding performance that surpasses their previous 397B MoE model. The model is 55.6GB (vs 807GB for previous) and shows impressive results in local testing with pelican/bicycle SVG generation.
author: Simon Willison

title: Changes to GitHub Copilot Individual plans
description: GitHub tightened Copilot usage limits, paused individual plan signups, restricted Claude Opus 4.7 to Pro+ plan, and dropped previous Opus models. Agentic workflows have fundamentally changed compute demands - long-running parallelized sessions consume far more resources than original plan structure.
author: Simon Willison

title: Is Claude Code going to cost $100/month? Probably not—it's all very confusing
description: Anthropic quietly updated pricing page adding $100/month tier, then reverted. The situation around Claude Code pricing remains unclear with no official announcement.
author: Simon Willison

title: Firefox 150 includes fixes for 271 vulnerabilities from Claude Mythos Preview
description: Mozilla applied early Claude Mythos Preview model to Firefox evaluation, resulting in 271 vulnerability fixes. Firefox CTO: 'Defenders finally have a chance to win, decisively.'
author: Simon Willison (citing Bobby Holley)

title: Where's the raccoon with the ham radio? (ChatGPT Images 2.0)
description: OpenAI released ChatGPT Images 2.0. Sam Altman said the leap from gpt-image-1 to gpt-image-2 was equivalent to jumping from GPT-3 to GPT-5.
author: Simon Willison
